notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures on the battlefield is equal to or greater than 19.
description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
During your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
